sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Lighthouse is a location in Escape from Tarkov. It is the eighth map that was added to the game.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: The lighthouse at Cape Dalniy was an important strategic object on the way to Tarkov. During Contract Wars, it was the main entry point for USEC units and served as their base of operations. After the conflict, Scavs took a fancy to this place, until the old owners returned, who decided to stay in Tarkov and establish their own order.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: Lighthouse is initially only accessible by transiting. Direct access from the location selection screen is unlocked upon progressing through the story chapter Tour.

sections.heading: Features
sections.text: Be aware of Minefields, Claymores and Border Snipers!

sections.heading: Lighthouse
sections.text: The lighthouse at the peninsula territory is the home of Lightkeeper. The bridge that leads to the lighthouse is guarded by Zryachiy and full of Claymores. To safely pass the bridge, an encoded Digital secure DSP radio transmitter is required. It deactivates the claymores and has Zryachiy not shoot you. The questline to obtain one starts with To the Light - Trust but Verify. Harming Zryachiy, one of his followers, or a Lightkeeper acquainted PMC in the lighthouse premises will decode your Digital secure DSP radio transmitter if you have one. PMCs that are acquainted with Lightkeeper can kill unacquainted intruders without penalty.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
- Lighthouse is a returning map from both of Escape from Tarkov's predecessors, Contract Wars and Hired Ops, where it had an identical function in the story as the original entry point of USEC into Tarkov. However in Escape from Tarkov, the map was drastically remade and has very little similarities to its older Contract Wars and Hired Ops iterations.
- Lighthouse is referred to as "Cape Dalniy" in multiple quest dialogues. "Dalny" is also the nickname of the Kvantunskaya Oblast, a Russian territory in modern day China's Liaodong Peninsula.
- The lighthouse is based on the Aniva lighthouse which is located at the southern coast of Sakhalin, Russia.
